item.title: Show HN: I stole a game interaction and brought it to macOS (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description:
Hey HN, I made Peek, a Mac app for quickly checking the things you check often without switching apps.

You just need to hold the hotkey ( Fn by default) to bring up the websites and widgets you need in a layer over what you're doing. Release it and you're back. To interact with the contents inside, you just tap the hotkey to keep it open.

The idea came from FPS/MOBA/... games: you hold a key to check the scoreboard or map, then release it to get back to playing. I wanted that same quick interaction for the things I check while working.

Personally, I keep calendar widget, reminders widget and X feed for my Peek zone.

And few other things Peek can do:

- Add websites, local PDF and HTML files to Peek

- Built-in widgets: timezones, weather, stocks

- MCP: let your agents make custom widgets and add them to Peek

- Hide unwanted elements of a webpage

- Auto-refresh webpages

- Work over full-screen apps

- Use separate layouts for different displays

Peek is a one-time purchase, currently available at an early believer price of $3.99.

I'd love to hear what you'd keep in your Peek zone :)

I also made a launch video on YouTube: https://youtu.be/yziiGo_Hq6Q
